lines: Jordan Lee
+1 (555) 010-2468 | jordan.lee@example.com | example.com/code/jordan-lee
Date of birth: 14 Mar 1999 | Nationality: Canadian
EDUCATION
Western State University | M.S. in Computer Engineering | Metro City, USA | Sep 2024 - Expected Jun 2026
Eastern Institute of Technology | B.S. in Electrical Engineering | Metro City, Country | Sep 2018 - Jun 2022
EXPERIENCE
Lakeside Auto Parts | Mechanical Design Engineer | Metro City, Country | Jun 2025 - Present
- Designed stamping dies for automotive brackets in SolidWorks, cutting the scrap rate from 6% to 4% on two press lines.
- Ran tolerance stack-up analyses for 12 production parts and signed off first-article inspections with the supplier.
Mobility Systems Company | Machine Learning Engineering Intern | Metro City, USA | Oct 2024 - May 2025
- Improved diagnostic accuracy by 35% after fine-tuning a domain adapter on validated tool-use trajectories with assistant-only loss masking.
- Designed a routing layer that limits each of 3 specialist agents and an independent reviewer to their in-scope signals, cutting reviewer disagreement with specialist findings from 14% to 6%.

- Trained the triage agent with GRPO on grouped tool-use rollouts and a reward that penalises redundant calls, cutting tool calls per case 18% and end-to-end latency 5% versus the SFT baseline at equal accuracy.
- Wrote the evaluation harness the team used to compare 14 adapter checkpoints on accuracy, citation quality and latency, catching 2 accuracy regressions before release.
- Fine-tuned the adapter with assistant-only loss masking so the model would learn to reproduce the tool outputs more faithfully.

- Built a diagnostics triage branch for an industrial inspection system that screens 800+ sensor signals per case with ML-extracted features, cutting the pending-case backlog 68% in the eight weeks after launch.
Eastern Robotics Co. | Junior Software Engineer | Metro City, Country | Aug 2022 - Jul 2024
- Cut GPU memory for fine-tuning the perception models by 4x by switching from FP32 to BF16 mixed precision.
- Reduced p95 API latency from 420 ms to 180 ms by adding a request cache and batching sensor reads, with load tests that fail the build if p95 exceeds 200 ms.
- Maintained the CI pipeline for the perception team's model releases and adds automated regression checks that shortened release cycles to 3 days.
- Migrated 30 robot-fleet services from cron jobs to an event queue with retries and dead-letter handling, removing the nightly backlogs that delayed morning dispatch.
PROJECTS
Agent Runtime Suite | Owner | TypeScript, Multi-Agent Systems | Aug 2025 - Present
- Drove adoption of AI-first engineering practices across the platform, accelerating delivery and improving outcomes for downstream teams.
- Kept working context under 10K tokens across a 100-turn stress test while the raw conversation grew 100x, using budgeted context layers and staged compaction.
- Separated concurrency pools and gated cache writes on stream completion, removing nested-pool deadlocks and lost tool results under 50-way fan-out.
Research-Agent Evaluation Framework | Contributor | LLM Evaluation | Feb 2025 - Jul 2025
- Integrated 8 citation and faithfulness metrics into an open-source research-agent framework's evaluation module.
- Showed the evaluator tracks injected degradation with a Kendall correlation of 0.89 across 400+ report-level trials that removed citations, sources and claims.
- Cut the pending-case backlog by two-thirds with a triage branch that screens 800+ sensor signals per case using ML-extracted features.
SKILLS
Programming: Python, TypeScript, Git
ML & Agents: PyTorch, LoRA, GRPO, agent evaluation

items.says: The résumé includes date of birth and nationality, personal details conventionally left off.
items.because: They do not help a reader assess the experience or qualifications.

items.says: The triage branch is credited with different backlog reductions in two entries that appear to describe the same result.
items.because: The matching branch details suggest a single accomplishment and may make readers question the figures or double credit.

items.says: Experience should appear above Education.
items.because: The current order puts degrees ahead of the career evidence.

items.says: The Lakeside Auto Parts role pulls the page toward mechanical design if the intended direction is ML or software engineering.
items.because: Without a connection to that direction, the role can distract from the ML and software evidence.

items.says: The tolerance analyses and first-article inspections have no stated outcome.
items.because: Their value is hard to judge without knowing whether they resolved a problem or enabled production.

items.says: The 35% diagnostic-accuracy improvement has no comparison baseline or evaluation set.
items.because: A reader cannot tell what the figure represents or how to assess it.

items.says: The method repeats the previous bullet, and its purpose adds no separate accomplishment.
items.because: The earlier bullet already connects assistant-only loss masking to an accuracy result.

items.says: The backlog reduction gives no reference level or comparison period.
items.because: The eight-week timeframe says when it was observed, not what the 68% was measured against.

items.says: The backlog reduction is buried after the system context and signal count.
items.because: A scanning reader reaches the strongest result only after the description and scope.

items.says: “ML-extracted features” does not identify the feature-extraction approach.
items.because: It is the line’s only stated technical method, so naming it would make the ML work easier to assess.

items.says: The FP32-to-BF16 switch alone does not establish the claimed 4x GPU-memory reduction.
items.because: A 4x reduction generally needs other changes or an unusual baseline, neither of which is identified.

items.says: The latency result comes after the implementation details.
items.because: Leading with the measured change would make the impact easier for a scanning reader to find.

items.says: “Maintained” and “adds” mix past and present tense in a role that ended in July 2024.
items.because: The shift makes it unclear whether the automated checks were part of the completed work.

items.says: The three-day release-cycle duration has no prior duration for comparison.
items.because: A reader cannot judge whether it represents a substantial improvement or a small change.

items.says: The dispatch-backlog result does not show how much backlog or delay was removed.
items.because: The 30-service count shows the scale of the work, not the size of the improvement.

items.says: The Eastern Robotics bullets do not establish whether their separate improvements formed one project or stretch of work.
items.because: A reader cannot tell whether the changes were connected or simply occurred during the same role.

items.says: “AI-first engineering practices” does not specify the practices adopted.
items.because: The phrase does not let a reader picture the contribution or recognize the relevant skill.

items.says: The claimed delivery and downstream benefits have no identified evidence of a change.
items.because: The bullet presents those benefits as achieved without naming a measured outcome.

items.says: “The raw conversation grew 100x” gives a ratio without a comparison basis.
items.because: A reader cannot tell what the raw conversation size is 100 times larger than.

items.says: Separating pools and gating cache writes do not by themselves establish that deadlocks and lost results were eliminated.
items.because: Dependency cycles, cancellation, write failures, and concurrency races could still cause those failures.

items.says: The metric integration has no stated outcome or capability it enabled.
items.because: The metric count shows scope, not what changed for the framework or its users.

items.says: The Kendall correlation does not identify the two variables or rankings correlated.
items.because: Without the comparison, a reader cannot interpret what it demonstrates about the evaluator.

items.says: The backlog claim repeats the internship’s industrial-inspection result without establishing that it belongs to this project.
items.because: The matching backlog, signal count, and features make it appear to be the same accomplishment credited under the internship.
